item.title: Vivo X300 FE Launch Date In India, Price, Specifications, Camera, Colours And More: What We Know So Far
item.description: Vivo is reportedly developing the X300 FE model to complement its existing X300 and X300 Pro series, although no official announcement has been made yet. item.title: Bengaluru Society Brawl On Camera: Punches, Kicks Fly Over Dog Walking And Peeing
item.description: A physical confrontation erupted among residents of a Bengaluru apartment complex over a dog walking dispute. The incident involved Tarun Arora, who took his dog near a designated area for senior citizens, leading to objections from the elderly residents.
